description: Évaluation préliminaire du risque d’inondation sur le bassin Loire-Bretagne (EPRI) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DREAL Centre-Val de Loire. L’évaluation préliminaire du risque d’inondation est un état des lieux de la sensibilité des territoires au risque d’inondation réalisé à partir des informations aisément mobilisables. Lors du 1er cycle de la directive inondations, elle a été arrêtée par le préfet coordonnateur de bassin en décembre 2011, sous la forme de quatre livres. Coverage: DREAL Centre-Val de Loire. The publisher named on the listing is DREAL Centre-Val de Loire. Its keywords include observation-de-la-terre-et-environnement, hvd. The listing shows 6 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-11-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
